## Production

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Production")]

### Conception

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: Conception")]

In January 2013, series co-creator [Ryan Murphy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ryan_Murphy_(producer) "Ryan Murphy (producer)") hinted that a clue about the third season would be hidden in the [tenth episode](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Name_Game_(American_Horror_Story) "The Name Game (American Horror Story)") of the [second season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Horror_Story:_Asylum "American Horror Story: Asylum").[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-16) In a later interview discussing that episode, he stated, "I sorta feel like for the third version I want to do something that's a little bit more 'evil glamour.' Just something that's a little bit more...one of the things that I missed this season was I really loved having that _[Romeo and Juliet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romeo\_and\_Juliet "Romeo and Juliet")_ youth story with [Violet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Violet_Harmon "Violet Harmon") and [Tate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tate_Langdon "Tate Langdon") [from the [first season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Horror_Story:_Murder_House "American Horror Story: Murder House")]. I want something like that again, and we're doing something like that in the third season. And we're contemplating shooting the show in a different place. We're contemplating shooting it in a place in the country where true horror has been."[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-17) In another interview, Murphy added that the season would be set in the modern-day.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Season3January-18)

Executive producer [Tim Minear](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Minear "Tim Minear") has stated that, while this season's tone might be lighter with more humor, the global themes of it will be "oppression of minorities of all kinds, and within that idea, minority groups going after each other and doing the work of the larger culture." He added, "While there is a strong feminist theme that runs throughout _Coven_, there are themes of race and themes of oppression, and themes of family – especially mothers and daughters."[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-huffingtonpost-19)

### Future season

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: Future season")]

In October 2016, Murphy stated that a future season of the show would feature a return/continuation of _Coven_. He stated that this is not the theme for season 7, but a later season. He also confirmed that [Lady Gaga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lady_Gaga "Lady Gaga")'s character from _[Roanoke](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American\_Horror\_Story:\_Roanoke "American Horror Story: Roanoke")_ is the first Supreme.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-CovenReturn-20) Later that month, Murphy announced that the season would be a _Coven_ and _Murder House_ crossover continuation. Merging stories, themes, and characters. He also stated that he had begun reaching out to actors from both seasons to reprise their respective roles. In 2018, Murphy announced the eighth season, _[Apocalypse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American\_Horror\_Story:\_Apocalypse "American Horror Story: Apocalypse")_, which would be the crossover season. _Apocalypse_ follows the world after a nuclear holocaust, and the events leading up to the end of the world, principally, the witches' fight against Michael Langdon, the antichrist who was born in _Murder House_.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-NewMurder-21)

### Casting

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: Casting")]

Series executive producers and co-creators Ryan Murphy and [Brad Falchuk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brad_Falchuk "Brad Falchuk") stated that, as with the second season, "many actors" would return for the third season in different roles.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Harnick-22)[Jessica Lange](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jessica_Lange "Jessica Lange"), [Evan Peters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evan_Peters "Evan Peters"), and [Sarah Paulson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarah_Paulson "Sarah Paulson") all confirmed their returns. Murphy added that Lange would portray a "real glamour-cat lady",[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Season3January-18) whose name was later revealed to be Fiona Goode.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-autogenerated7-23) Paulson said in an interview that her character would "definitely [be] different [to her season two character]." She added, "Basically, she's going to look different, and my relationship to Lange is going to be quite different this time. At the beginning of last season, no one knew that Lana would be the hero, so it's possible I could end up the evil one this year. As of right now, there will be some of Lana Winters' qualities in my character, but I don't know for sure."[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-24)[Taissa Farmiga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taissa_Farmiga "Taissa Farmiga"), who played a lead role in the first season, starred as Zoe Benson, a character involved in a prominent romance with Peters' character.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-farmiga-conroyhire-25)[Lily Rabe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lily_Rabe "Lily Rabe") and [Frances Conroy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frances_Conroy "Frances Conroy") portrayed series regulars Misty Day and Myrtle Snow, respectively.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-farmiga-conroyhire-25)[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Rabe-26)[Kathy Bates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kathy_Bates "Kathy Bates") co-starred as [Delphine LaLaurie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delphine_LaLaurie "Delphine LaLaurie"), an evil woman from the past who tortures her slaves.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-27) Murphy stated that Bates' character would be "five times worse than [her] _[Misery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Misery\_(film) "Misery (film)")_ character" and is also inspired by a "true event".[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-28) It was reported on May 22, 2013, that [Emma Roberts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Roberts "Emma Roberts") would co-star as Madison Montgomery, a difficult Hollywood starlet.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Roberts1-29)

In May 2013, Murphy announced via Twitter that [Angela Bassett](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angela_Bassett "Angela Bassett") and [Patti LuPone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patti_LuPone "Patti LuPone") had joined the cast.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-30)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Harnick-22) Bassett later confirmed she would be playing voodoo priestess, [Marie Laveau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marie_Laveau "Marie Laveau"). In an interview, LuPone said that her character, Joan Ramsey, would not be a witch but "the personification of the religious right, 'like [Piper Laurie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piper_Laurie "Piper Laurie") in _[Carrie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carrie\_(1976\_film) "Carrie (1976 film)")_.'"[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Lupone-31)[Gabourey Sidibe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabourey_Sidibe "Gabourey Sidibe") appeared in 12 episodes of the season portraying Queenie, a young witch, whose prominent ability allows her to become a human [voodoo doll](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voodoo_doll "Voodoo doll").[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-32) First season actress [Jamie Brewer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jamie_Brewer "Jamie Brewer") recurred as Nan, a young witch who is clairvoyant.

In July and August 2013, Murphy announced through [Twitter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitter "Twitter") that _Murder House_ actors [Denis O'Hare](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denis_O'Hare "Denis O'Hare") and [Alexandra Breckenridge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexandra_Breckenridge "Alexandra Breckenridge") had joined the cast in unknown roles, later known as Spalding and Kaylee, respectively.[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-OHare-33)[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-ABreck-34) Also in August, Murphy announced that [Christine Ebersole](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christine_Ebersole "Christine Ebersole") would be playing a "[Glinda the Good Witch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glinda_the_Good_Witch "Glinda the Good Witch")-type of gal", who is Fiona's predecessor.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-35) In an interview, Jessica Lange revealed that [Mare Winningham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mare_Winningham "Mare Winningham") had joined the cast as Peters' character's mother, Alicia Spencer.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-36)[Leslie Jordan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leslie_Jordan "Leslie Jordan") announced that he had joined the cast as Quentin Fleming, a high-ranking witch.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-37) In September 2013, [Alexander Dreymon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexander_Dreymon "Alexander Dreymon") was cast in the role of Luke Ramsey. Described as "the handsome young man who moves in next door to the Academy".[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-dreymon-38)[Danny Huston](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Huston "Danny Huston"), [Josh Hamilton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josh_Hamilton_(actor) "Josh Hamilton (actor)"), and [Lance Reddick](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lance_Reddick "Lance Reddick") all recurred throughout the season as [the Axeman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_of_New_Orleans "The Axeman of New Orleans"), Hank Foxx, and [Papa Legba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papa_Legba "Papa Legba"), respectively. Murphy also invited singer [Stevie Nicks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stevie_Nicks "Stevie Nicks") to be a part of the season. She appeared in two episodes, "[The Magical Delights of Stevie Nicks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Magical_Delights_of_Stevie_Nicks "The Magical Delights of Stevie Nicks")" and "[The Seven Wonders](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Seven_Wonders_(American_Horror_Story) "The Seven Wonders (American Horror Story)")".

### Filming

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: Filming")]

[Principal photography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_photography "Principal photography") for the season began on July 23, 2013, and concluded January 17, 2014,[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-39) in [New Orleans, Louisiana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Orleans,_Louisiana "New Orleans, Louisiana").[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-post-40) The casting call reads, "After two seasons shooting in Los Angeles, the series moves to [New Orleans] for its third season. Filming begins July 23, 2013, in New Orleans, Louisiana and [will be] completed on January 17, 2014."[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-41) Despite Ryan Murphy stating that the third season would take place in multiple cities,[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Season3January-18) New Orleans is the primary setting of the third installment.[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-huffingtonpost-19) The Buckner Mansion, a 19th-century [Greek Revival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greek_Revival_architecture "Greek Revival architecture") home in the [Garden District](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garden_District,_New_Orleans "Garden District, New Orleans") neighborhood of New Orleans, was used for exterior shots of Miss Robichaux's Academy.[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-42)[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-43)[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-44)

## Reception

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=15 "Edit section: Reception")]

### Critical response

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: Critical response")]

_American Horror Story: Coven_ received positive reviews from critics. The review aggregation website [Rotten Tomatoes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes "Rotten Tomatoes") reported an 85% approval rating, with an average rating of 7.25/10, based on 221 reviews, becoming the best-reviewed season of the series on that site. The site's consensus reads, "A noteworthy ensemble cast combined with creepy storytelling and campy, outrageous thrills make _American Horror Story: Coven_ a potently structured fright-fest."[[48]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-RTCoven-49) The season scored 71 out of 100 on [Metacritic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metacritic "Metacritic"), based on 24 reviews.[[49]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-50)

Anne T Donahue of _[The Guardian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Guardian "The Guardian")_ stated that _Coven_ "could be _American Horror Story_'s best instalment yet," writing, "That's not to say _Coven_ is perfect. It's been called out as glorified slave-torture porn in the US, and it's important that Madame LeLaurie's storyline comes full circle, and that slavery is handled in a responsible way. The same goes for Zoe's storyline, and the incidences of sexual assault within this season, too. But _American Horror Story_ can handle it. And while it's obviously over-the-top, its broader social commentary makes it a unique series, unlike anything we've seen on television before. It's a conventional horror story, but it's America's horror story too. Just try making it through an episode without hiding behind the sofa."[[50]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-51) In their post-season reviews, _[The Michigan Daily](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Michigan\_Daily "The Michigan Daily")_ gave _Coven_ a B+, saying, "And while its conclusion, appropriately titled "The Seven Wonders", never quite matched the high standard it set for itself throughout the season, _Coven_'s reputation will nonetheless remain a solid one."[[51]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-52) Jeff Jensen of _[Entertainment Weekly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Entertainment\_Weekly "Entertainment Weekly")_ gave the season a B rating and said, "I can't deny my experience: Week to week, the excesses of _Coven_ were wickedly amusing. Next year, I hope _American Horror Story_ can be more than that, and with less."[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-53)

In contrast, _Coven_ was also met with negative reviews from some critics. _[The A.V. Club](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_A.V.\_Club "The A.V. Club")_ gave the season a low rating of D+, with critic [Emily St. James](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emily_St._James "Emily St. James") remarking, "It lurched drunkenly from idea to idea, never settling on one long enough to build anything of worth."[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-54) Some critics, like Amanda Kay LeBlanc, state that the series is ineffective in completely opposing the ideas of racism, oppression, and racial conflict that are integral to _Coven_'s conception.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-55) "Although the narrative of _Coven_ explicitly decries racism," she writes, "it simultaneously invests in colorblind racist narratives. Whiteness is central in _Coven_, operating through discourse that ignores racial difference and contemporary forms of oppression and erasure."[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-:03-56) She additionally argues that _Coven_ excessively depends on and uses the imagery of violence against black people for entertainment and plot progression.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-:03-56)

### Ratings

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=American_Horror_Story:_Coven&action=edit&section=17 "Edit section: Ratings")]

See also: [American Horror Story §Ratings](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Horror_Story#Ratings "American Horror Story")

_Coven_'s premiere episode, "[Bitchcraft](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitchcraft_(American_Horror_Story) "Bitchcraft (American Horror Story)")", was watched by 5.54 million viewers, which, at the time, was the highest total viewers of any _American Horror Story_ episode.[[56]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-Bitchcraft-57) It was surpassed by the fourth season's premiere, "[Monsters Among Us](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monsters_Among_Us "Monsters Among Us")", which received 6.13 million viewers during its broadcast.[[57]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-58) The ratings slipped for the second episode, delivering 4.51 million viewers and a 2.5 rating among adults 18-49 – down 17% from the premiere.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-59) The rest of the season's episodes remained relatively steady in ratings; the episode with the lowest viewing numbers was the penultimate episode, "[Go to Hell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_to_Hell_(American_Horror_Story) "Go to Hell (American Horror Story)")".

[Nielsen Media Research](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nielsen_Media_Research "Nielsen Media Research"), which records streaming viewership on certain U.S. television screens, reported that _American Horror Story: Coven_ garnered 1.18 billion minutes of watch time, averaging 90.9 million minutes viewed per episode, between May 1, 2024, and August 31, 2026.[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Axeman_(American_Horror_Story)#cite_note-60)

# 게스트로 Chrome 탐색

공용 컴퓨터를 사용하거나 다른 사용자와 컴퓨터를 공유하는 경우 게스트 모드에서 방문한 웹사이트가 브라우저 기록에 표시되지 않습니다.

게스트 모드에서는 다른 Chrome 프로필의 정보를 찾거나 변경할 수 없습니다. 게스트 모드를 종료하면 내 탐색 활동이 컴퓨터에서 삭제됩니다.

게스트 모드의 사용 용도:

*   다른 사용자에게 내 컴퓨터를 빌려주거나 내가 다른 사용자의 컴퓨터를 빌려 쓰는 경우
*   도서관, 카페 등에서 공용 컴퓨터를 사용하는 경우

내 컴퓨터에서 비공개로 탐색하려면 [시크릿 모드를 사용](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95464)하세요. 방문 기록이 저장되지 않으며 내 정보와 설정을 계속 확인할 수 있습니다.

**도움말:** 신뢰할 수 있는 기기에서만 민감한 웹사이트에 로그인하세요.

[컴퓨터](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6130773?hl=ko)[Android 휴대전화 및 태블릿](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6130773?hl=ko)[iPhone/iPad](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6130773?hl=ko)

더보기
1.   더보기

## 게스트 모드 열기

1.   컴퓨터에서 Chrome을 엽니다.
2.   오른쪽 상단에서 프로필 ![Image 1: 프로필](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/ctV0QX29Bg_C5H9X55WX5qRw0B6TtSqwM-aa0Ftx9kirVzMJU8NZmK0QUC724NV-2_E=w36-h36)을 선택합니다.
3.   **게스트 프로필**을 엽니다.

**도움말:**

*   컴퓨터에 관리 대상 사용자가 있고 관리 대상이 아닌 모든 프로필이 잠금 설정된 경우 게스트 모드를 사용할 수 없습니다.

*   Chromebook에서는 게스트 모드를 사용할 수 없습니다. [Chromebook을 게스트로 사용하는 방법을 알아보세요](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/1057090).

## 게스트 모드 종료하기

 게스트 모드를 닫는 방법은 다음과 같습니다. 
*   **Windows 및 Linux:** 오른쪽 상단에서 닫기 ![Image 2: 닫기](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/VYhF4U2_Ulo5TxrJblqA1dFmKF17woYZFvBzgdMXFCGOyf7EoT7mfBDj2f5cDrDO_9I=w36-h36)를 선택합니다.
*   **Mac:** 왼쪽 상단에서 닫기 ![Image 3: 닫기](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/VYhF4U2_Ulo5TxrJblqA1dFmKF17woYZFvBzgdMXFCGOyf7EoT7mfBDj2f5cDrDO_9I=w36-h36)를 선택합니다.

 또는 
1.   오른쪽 상단에서 프로필 ![Image 4: 프로필](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/ctV0QX29Bg_C5H9X55WX5qRw0B6TtSqwM-aa0Ftx9kirVzMJU8NZmK0QUC724NV-2_E=w36-h36)을 선택합니다.
2.   메뉴에서 **게스트 종료**를 선택합니다.

방문 기록, 쿠키, 사이트 데이터가 삭제됩니다.

### 다른 사용자가 게스트 모드에서 볼 수 있는 정보

게스트 모드를 사용하면 Chrome에서의 탐색 활동이 로컬 기록에 저장되지 않지만, 신뢰할 수 있는 사용자의 기기에서만 민감한 웹사이트에 로그인해야 합니다. 기기 소유자가 활동 및 위치와 같은 내 데이터에 액세스할 수 있습니다. 이 데이터는 다음 위치에서 계속 표시될 수 있습니다.

*   방문하는 웹사이트(해당 사이트에서 사용된 광고 및 리소스 포함)
*   로그인한 웹사이트
*   고용주, 학교 등 내가 사용하는 네트워크를 실행하는 모든 사용자
*   인터넷 서비스 제공업체(ISP)
*   검색엔진 
    *   현재 게스트 탐색 세션에서 활동한 내용이나 위치를 기반으로 검색엔진에 추천 검색어가 표시될 수 있습니다. Google에서 검색하면 Google에서는 항상 사용자가 검색하는 대략적인 위치를 추정합니다. [Google에서 검색 시 사용되는 위치 정보에 관해 자세히 알아보기](https://support.google.com/websearch/answer/179386)

이러한 서비스 중에는 스트림하거나 상호작용할 수 있는 콘텐츠가 포함된 서비스도 많습니다.

Google 서비스는 서로 협업하도록 구성되어 있어, 하나의 활동에서 다음 활동으로 더욱 쉽게 이동할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 Calendar 일정에 주소가 포함된 경우 주소를 클릭하면 Google 지도에 해당 주소의 이동 경로가 표시됩니다.

### Google 서비스 개발, 개선, 업데이트

![Image 6](https://www.gstatic.com/identity/boq/policies/privacy/tos_2024/04-develop-improve-and-update-google-services-lightmode.svg)

Google은 서비스 개선을 위해 지속적으로 새로운 기술 및 기능을 개발합니다. 예를 들어, 동시 번역을 제공하거나 스팸 및 멀웨어를 더 효과적으로 감지하고 차단하기 위해 인공지능과 머신러닝을 사용합니다. Google은 이러한 지속적인 개선의 일환으로 기능을 추가하거나 삭제하고, 서비스에 대한 제한을 늘리거나 줄이며, 새로운 서비스를 제공하거나 기존 서비스의 제공을 중단하기도 합니다. 서비스에 다운로드 가능하거나 선탑재된 소프트웨어가 필요하거나 포함되는 경우 새로운 버전 또는 기능이 제공되면 소프트웨어가 기기에서 자동으로 업데이트되기도 합니다. 일부 서비스의 경우 귀하가 자동 업데이트 설정을 조정할 수 있습니다.

Google은 면밀한 제품 연구 프로그램을 가지고 있어, 서비스를 변경하거나 서비스 제공을 중단하기 전에 사용자로서 귀하의 이해관계, 귀하의 합리적 기대, 귀하 및 다른 사용자에게 미칠 수 있는 잠재적인 영향을 신중하게 고려합니다. Google은 성능 또는 보안을 개선하거나, 법률을 준수하거나, 불법 활동 또는 서비스 악용을 방지하거나, 발전된 기술을 반영하는 등 타당한 사유가 있는 경우, 또는 일부 기능이나 전체 서비스가 더 이상 충분한 인기나 경제성이 없는 경우에만 서비스를 변경하거나 중단합니다.

귀하의 Google 서비스 사용에 부정적인 영향을 미치는 중대한 변경사항이 있거나 서비스 제공을 중단할 경우, Google은 합당한 사전 통지를 전달합니다. 다만, 서비스 악용을 방지하거나, 법적 요구에 응하거나, 보안 및 운용가능성 관련 문제를 해결하는 등 긴급한 상황은 예외로 합니다. 또한 Google은 관련 법률 및 정책에 따라 [Google 테이크아웃](https://takeout.google.com/settings/takeout?hl=ko)을 사용해 Google 계정에서 [귀하의 콘텐츠](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-your-content)를 내보낼 기회를 제공합니다.

### 타인에 대한 존중

![Image 8](https://www.gstatic.com/identity/boq/policies/privacy/tos_2024/06-respect-others-lightmode.svg)

Google은 모든 사용자가 서로 존중하는 환경을 유지하길 원하며, 이를 위해 귀하는 다음과 같은 기본적인 행동 규범을 준수해야 합니다.
*   수출 규제, 제재 및 인신매매 관련 법률을 포함한 관련 법률 준수
*   개인 정보 보호 및 지적 재산권을 포함한 타인의 권리 존중
*   타인 또는 본인을 학대하거나 위해를 가하는 행위(예: 타인에 대한 오도, 기망, 불법 명의 도용, 명예 훼손, 놀림, 괴롭힘, 스토킹) 또는 그러한 학대나 위해를 가하겠다는 위협을 하거나 조장하는 행위 금지

Google의 [생성형 AI 금지된 사용 정책](https://policies.google.com/terms/generative-ai/use-policy?gl=KR&hl=ko)과 같은 Google의 [서비스별 추가 약관 및 정책](https://policies.google.com/terms/service-specific?gl=KR&hl=ko)에는 해당 서비스를 사용하는 누구든지 반드시 준수해야 하는 적절한 행동에 대한 추가적인 세부정보가 설명되어 있습니다. 타인이 그러한 규칙을 준수하지 않는 사례를 발견할 경우 귀하는 많은 Google 서비스에서 [악용사례를 신고](https://support.google.com/groups/answer/81275?hl=ko)할 수 있습니다. Google은 신고된 악용사례를 처리할 때 _[문제 상황에서의 조치](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#taking-action)_ 항목에 설명된 절차를 제공합니다.

### Google 서비스 악용 금지

Google 서비스에 액세스하거나 이를 이용하는 대부분의 사용자는 인터넷의 보안과 개방성을 유지하기 위한 일반적인 규칙을 숙지하고 있습니다. 안타깝게도 이러한 규칙을 준수하지 않는 소수의 사용자가 있기에 Google에서는 Google 서비스와 사용자를 악용으로부터 보호하고자 여기에 규칙을 설명합니다. 이에 따라 다음과 같습니다.

[귀하의 콘텐츠](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-your-content)는 귀하에게 귀속됩니다. 즉, 귀하의 콘텐츠의 [지적 재산권](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-intellectual-property-rights)은 귀하가 보유합니다. 예를 들어, 귀하는 귀하가 작성한 리뷰와 같이 직접 만든 창작물에 대한 지적 재산권을 갖습니다. 또는 타인이 권한을 부여한 경우 타인의 창작물을 공유할 권리를 보유할 수 있습니다.

Google은 본 라이선스를 통해 다음 사항들을 할 수 있습니다.

*   귀하의 콘텐츠를 호스팅, 복제, 배포, 전달 및 사용(예: 귀하가 어디에서나 귀하의 콘텐츠에 접근할 수 있도록 Google 시스템에 콘텐츠를 저장)

### 목적

본 라이선스의 목적은 다음으로 제한됩니다.

*   **서비스의 운영 및 개선**. 서비스가 의도한 대로 제공될 수 있도록 하는 것과 새로운 기능을 만드는 것을 의미합니다. 여기에는 자동화된 시스템 및 알고리즘을 사용하여 다음과 같은 목적으로 귀하의 콘텐츠를 분석하는 것도 포함됩니다.

이러한 분석은 콘텐츠 전송, 수신, 저장 시에 수행됩니다.
*   **귀하가 공개적으로 공유한 콘텐츠를 서비스의 홍보를 위해 사용**. 예를 들어, Google 앱을 홍보하기 위해 귀하가 작성한 리뷰를 인용할 수 있습니다. 또는 Google Play의 홍보 목적으로 귀하가 Play 스토어에서 제공하는 앱의 스크린샷을 사용할 수도 있습니다.

# Google 서비스 사용

## 귀하의 Google 계정

[연령 요건을 충족하는 경우](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/1350409?hl=ko) 언제든지 편의를 위해 [Google 계정을 만들 수 있습니다](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/27441?hl=ko). 일부 [서비스](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-services)는 이용을 위해 Google 계정을 요구합니다. 예를 들어, Gmail을 사용하려면, 이메일을 보내고 받기 위한 공간을 갖기 위해 Google 계정이 있어야 합니다.

Google 계정을 보호하기 위해 합리적인 조치를 취하는 것을 포함하여 Google 계정 사용에 관한 책임은 귀하에게 있습니다. Google은 귀하가 [보안 진단](https://myaccount.google.com/security-checkup?hl=ko)을 정기적으로 사용할 것을 권장합니다.

## 기관 또는 사업체를 위한 Google 서비스 사용

사업체, 비영리단체, 학교를 비롯한 여러 [기관](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-organization)에서 Google [서비스](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-services)를 활용합니다. 기관을 위해 Google 서비스를 사용하려면 다음 조건을 충족해야 합니다.
*   기관의 권한있는 대표자가 본 약관에 동의할 것.
*   귀하의 기관 관리자가 귀하에게 Google 계정을 배정할 것. 해당 관리자는 귀하에게 추가적인 규칙을 준수하도록 요구할 수 있으며, 귀하의 Google 계정에 접근하거나 계정을 사용 중지할 수 있습니다.

## 서비스 관련 커뮤니케이션

귀하에게 서비스를 제공하기 위해 Google이 서비스 공지 또는 기타 정보를 보내는 경우가 있습니다. Google이 귀하와 커뮤니케이션하는 방식을 자세히 알아보려면 Google [개인정보처리방침](https://policies.google.com/privacy?gl=KR&hl=ko)을 참조하시기 바랍니다.

귀하가 Google 서비스 개선을 위한 제안 등의 의견을 제출하는 경우 Google은 귀하에 대한 의무 없이 귀하의 의견을 바탕으로 조치를 취할 수 있습니다.

## 셀룰러, Wi-Fi 및 기타 네트워크 연결 비용

Google 서비스는 사용자가 서비스 또는 기기를 능동적으로 사용하고 있지 않을 때도 인터넷을 자주 사용할 수 있습니다. Google은 소프트웨어 업데이트를 제공하고 Google 서비스, 보안, 사용자 환경 및/또는 광고를 포함하는 Google 운영을 개선하는 등 다양한 목적을 위해 이러한 방식으로 인터넷을 사용합니다. 이러한 사용은 사용자의 셀룰러, Wi-Fi 및/또는 기타 네트워크 연결을 통해 이루어지며, 이동통신사 또는 인터넷 서비스 제공업체에서 제공하는 데이터 허용량에서 차감될 수 있습니다. 귀하는 이와 같은 모든 네트워크 이용 및 관련 비용에 대한 책임을 집니다. 귀하의 셀룰러 또는 인터넷 서비스 요금제, 기기 및 네트워크 설정을 확인해 보세요.

다른 사람이 귀하의 [지적 재산권](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-intellectual-property-rights)을 침해한다고 판단하는 경우 [침해 사실을 신고](https://support.google.com/legal/answer/3110420?hl=ko)하여 Google이 적절한 조치를 취하도록 할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 Google은 [저작권 도움말 센터](https://support.google.com/legal/topic/4558877?hl=ko)에 명시된 대로 [저작권](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-copyright)을 반복적으로 침해하는 사용자의 Google 계정을 정지 또는 폐쇄할 수 있습니다.

Google은 (1) 서비스 내 변경사항 또는 사업 방식의 변화를 반영하거나(예: 새로운 서비스, 기능, 기술, 가격 또는 혜택을 추가하거나 기존의 것들을 삭제하는 경우), (2) 법령, 규제 또는 보안상의 이유가 있거나, (3) 서비스 악용 또는 위해를 방지하기 위해 본 약관 및 [서비스별 추가 약관](https://policies.google.com/terms/service-specific?gl=KR&hl=ko)을 변경할 수 있습니다.

본 약관 또는 [서비스별 추가 약관](https://policies.google.com/terms/service-specific?gl=KR&hl=ko)에 중대한 변경사항이 있을 경우, Google은 (1) 사용자에게 편익을 주는 새로운 서비스 또는 기능을 출시하는 경우나, (2) 진행 중인 악용사례를 방지하거나 현지 법규에 대응하는 등 긴급한 상황이 있는 경우를 제외하고는, 30일 전에 사전 통지를 하고, 변경사항을 검토할 기회를 제공할 것입니다. 새로운 약관에 동의하지 않으면 [귀하의 콘텐츠](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-your-content)를 삭제하고 서비스 이용을 중지해야 합니다. 귀하는 [Google 계정을 폐쇄](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32046?hl=ko)함으로써 언제든지 Google과의 관계를 종료할 수도 있습니다.

# 정의

### 계열사

Google 그룹사(Google LLC 및 그 자회사들)에 속한 법인으로, Google Ireland Limited, Google Commerce Limited, Google Dialer Inc 등 EU에서 소비자 서비스를 제공하는 회사들을 포함합니다.

### 국가 버전

Google 계정이 있다면 다음을 확인하기 위해 계정이 국가(또는 지역)와 연결됩니다.

*   사용자에게 [서비스](https://policies.google.com/terms/definitions?gl=KR&hl=ko#toc-terms-services)를 제공하고 서비스 이용에 따른 사용자의 정보를 처리하는 Google [제휴사](https://policies.google.com/terms/definitions?gl=KR&hl=ko#toc-terms-affiliates)
*   Google과 사용자의 관계를 다루는 약관 버전

로그아웃 상태에서는 Google 서비스를 이용하는 위치에 따라 국가 버전이 결정됩니다. 계정이 있다면 [로그인](https://accounts.google.com/ServiceLogin?hl=ko&continue=https://policies.google.com/terms?gl%3DKR%26hl%3Dko)하여 약관을 보고 연결된 국가를 확인하세요.

### 귀하의 콘텐츠

다음의 예시와 같이 귀하가 Google 서비스를 이용해 생성, 업로드, 제출, 저장, 전송, 수신 또는 공유하는 것들을 의미합니다.

*   귀하가 생성하는 Docs, Sheets 및 Slides
*   귀하가 Blogger에 업로드하는 블로그 게시물
*   귀하가 Google 지도에 제출하는 리뷰
*   귀하가 Google Drive에 저장하는 동영상
*   귀하가 Gmail을 통해 주고 받는 이메일
*   귀하가 Google 포토를 통해 친구와 공유하는 사진
*   귀하가 Google과 공유하는 여행 일정

### 기관

개인이 아닌 회사, 비영리단체 또는 학교 등의 법인을 의미합니다.

### 면책

소송과 같은 법적 절차로 인해 다른 개인 또는 기관이 입게되는 손실을 보상하는 개인 또는 기관의 계약상 의무입니다.

### 보증

제품 또는 서비스가 일정한 수준의 성능을 제공한다는 보장을 의미합니다.

### 부인

특정인의 법적 책임을 제한하는 진술입니다.

### 비즈니스 사용자

소비자가 아닌 개인 또는 법인입니다('소비자' 용어 설명 참조).

### 상표

상거래에 사용되며, 특정 개인 또는 기관의 상품이나 서비스를 다른 개인 또는 기관의 것과 구별할 수 있게 하는 기호, 명칭 및 이미지입니다.

### 서비스

다음을 포함하여, 본 약관이 적용되며 [https://policies.google.com/terms/service-specific](https://policies.google.com/terms/service-specific?gl=KR&hl=ko)에 명시된 Google 제품 및 서비스를 말합니다.

*   앱 및 사이트(예: Google 검색 및 Google 지도)
*   플랫폼(예: Google 쇼핑)
*   결합된 서비스(예: 타사 앱 또는 사이트에 삽입된 Google 지도)
*   기기 및 기타 상품(예: Google Nest)

이러한 서비스 중에는 스트림하거나 상호작용할 수 있는 콘텐츠가 포함된 서비스도 많습니다.

### 소비자

거래, 영업, 제작 또는 직업 외에 개인적이며 비상업적인 목적으로 Google 서비스를 사용하는 개인입니다. ('비즈니스 사용자' 용어 설명 참조)

### 저작권

원저작물(예: 블로그 게시물, 사진 또는 동영상)의 제작자가 타인의 원저작물 사용 여부와 방식을 결정할 수 있도록 하는 법적 권리로, 특정한 제한 및 예외(예: '공정 사용' 및 '공정 취급')가 적용됩니다.

### 지적 재산권 (IP 권리)

발명(특허권), 문학 및 예술작품(저작권), 디자인(디자인권) 및 상거래에 사용되는 기호, 명칭, 이미지(상표권)와 같이 사람의 생각을 바탕으로 한 창작물에 대한 권리입니다. 지적 재산권은 귀하, 다른 개인 또는 기관이 보유할 수 있습니다.

### 책임

청구나 주장의 근거가 계약, 불법행위(과실 포함) 또는 다른 이유인지 불문하고, 또한 손실이 합리적으로 예견 또는 예상될 수 있었는지와 무관하게, 모든 유형의 법적 청구나 주장으로 인해 발생하는 손실을 의미합니다.

 All ages admitted 

A G-rated motion picture contains nothing in theme, language, nudity, sex, violence or other matters that, in the view of the Rating Board, would offend parents whose younger children view the motion picture. The G rating is not a "certificate of approval," nor does it signify a "children's" motion picture. Some snippets of language may go beyond polite conversation but they are common everyday expressions. No stronger words are present in G-rated motion pictures. Depictions of violence are minimal. No nudity, sex scenes or drug use are present in the motion picture.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 9: G](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Green_Theat_G.jpg)

![Image 10](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/pg_icon.svg)

 Some material may not be suitable for children 

A PG-rated motion picture should be investigated by parents before they let their younger children attend. The PG rating indicates, in the view of the Rating Board, that parents may consider some material unsuitable for their children, and parents should make that decision.

The more mature themes in some PG-rated motion pictures may call for parental guidance. There may be some profanity and some depictions of violence or brief nudity. But these elements are not deemed so intense as to require that parents be strongly cautioned beyond the suggestion of parental guidance. There is no drug use content in a PG-rated motion picture.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 11: PG](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_PG.jpg)

![Image 12](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/pg-13_icon.svg)

 Some material may be inappropriate for children under 13 

A PG-13 rating is a sterner warning by the Rating Board to parents to determine whether their children under age 13 should view the motion picture, as some material might not be suited for them. A PG-13 motion picture may go beyond the PG rating in theme, violence, nudity, sensuality, language, adult activities or other elements, but does not reach the restricted R category. The theme of the motion picture by itself will not result in a rating greater than PG-13, although depictions of activities related to a mature theme may result in a restricted rating for the motion picture.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 13: PG-13](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_PG13.jpg)

![Image 14](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/r_icon.svg)

 Under 17 requires accompanying parent or adult guardian 

An R-rated motion picture, in the view of the Rating Board, contains some adult material. An R-rated motion picture may include adult themes, adult activity, hard language, intense or persistent violence, sexually-oriented nudity, drug abuse or other elements, so that parents are counseled to take this rating very seriously. Children under 17 are not allowed to attend R-rated motion pictures unaccompanied by a parent or adult guardian. Parents are strongly urged to find out more about R-rated motion pictures in determining their suitability for their children. Generally, it is not appropriate for parents to bring their young children with them to R-rated motion pictures.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 15: R](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_R.jpg)

![Image 16](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/nc-17_icon.svg)

 No One 17 and Under Admitted 

An NC-17 rated motion picture is one that, in the view of the Rating Board, most parents would consider patently too adult for their children 17 and under. No children will be admitted. NC-17 does not mean "obscene" or "pornographic" in the common or legal meaning of those words, and should not be construed as a negative judgment in any sense. The rating simply signals that the content is appropriate only for an adult audience. An NC-17 rating can be based on violence, sex, aberrational behavior, drug abuse or any other element that most parents would consider too strong and therefore off-limits for viewing by their children.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

## Cookie Notice

This Cookie Notice (“Notice”) explains how NBCUniversal and [its affiliates](https://www.nbcuniversal.com/brands) (“NBCUniversal” or “we”), along with our partners, including advertisers and vendors, use cookies and similar tracking technologies when you use our websites, applications, such as games, interactive TV, voice-activated assistants, and other services that link to this policy, as well as connected devices, including those used in our theme parks (“Services”). This Notice provides more information about these technologies, your choices, and is part of the NBCUniversal Privacy Policy available [here](https://www.nbcuniversal.com/privacy). You should read the Privacy Policy and this Notice for a full picture of NBCUniversal’s use of your information.

**WHAT ARE COOKIES AND HOW ARE THEY USED?**

Like many companies, we use cookies (small text files placed on your computer or device) and other tracking technologies on the Services (referred to together from this point forward as “Cookies”, unless otherwise stated), including HTTP cookies, HTML5 and Flash local storage/flash cookies, web beacons/GIFs, embedded scripts, ETags/cache browsers, and software development kits.

**First-party Cookies**

First-party Cookies are placed by us (including through the use of third-party service providers) and are used to allow you to use the Services and their features and to assist in analytics activities.

**Third-party Cookies**

Certain third parties may place their Cookies on your device and use them to recognize your device when you visit the Services and when you visit other websites or online services. These third parties collect and use this information pursuant to their own privacy policies. Third-party Cookies enable certain features or functionalities, and advertising, to be provided on the Services.

**Types of Cookies**

The Services use the following types of first and third-party Cookies for these purposes:

**Strictly Necessary Cookies:** These Cookies are required for Service functionality, including for system administration, security and fraud prevention, and to enable any purchasing capabilities. You can set your browser to block these Cookies, but some parts of the site may not function properly.

**Information Storage and Access:** These Cookies allow us and our partners to store and access information on the device, such as device identifiers.

**Measurement and Analytics:** These Cookies collect data regarding your usage of and performance of the Services, apply market research to generate audiences, and measure the delivery and effectiveness of content and advertising. We and our third-party vendors use these Cookies to perform analytics, so we can improve the content and user experience, develop new products and services, and for statistical purposes. They are also used to recognize you and provide further insights across platforms and devices for the above purposes.

**Personalization Cookies:** These Cookies enable us to provide certain features, such as determining if you are a first-time visitor, capping message frequency, remembering choices you have made (e.g., your language preferences, time zone), and assist you with logging in after registration (including across platforms and devices). These Cookies also allow your device to receive and send information, so you can see and interact with ads and content.

**Content Selection and Delivery Cookies:** Data collected under this category can also be used to select and deliver personalized content, such as news articles and videos.

**Ad Selection and Delivery Cookies:** These Cookies are used to collect data about your browsing habits, your use of the Services, your preferences, and your interaction with advertisements across platforms and devices for the purpose of delivering interest-based advertising content on the Services and on third-party sites. Third-party sites and services also use interest-based Advertising Cookies to deliver content, including advertisements relevant to your interests on the Services and third-party services. If you reject these Cookies, you may see contextual advertising that may be less relevant to you.

**Social Media Cookies:** These Cookies are set by social media platforms on the Services to enable you to share content with your friends and networks. Social media platforms have the ability to track your online activity outside of the Services. This may impact the content and messages you see on other services you visit.

We and third parties may associate Measurement And Analytics Cookies, Personalization Cookies, Content Selection, Delivery Cookies, and Reporting, Ad Selection, Delivery and Reporting Cookies, and Social Media Cookies with other information we have about you.

**COOKIE MANAGEMENT**

Depending on where you live, you may be able to adjust your Cookie preferences at any time via the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer of relevant websites. You can also use the methods described below to manage Cookies. You must take such steps on each browser or device that you use. If you replace, change or upgrade your browser or device, or delete your cookies, you may need to use these opt-out tools again. As some Cookie-management solutions also rely on Cookies, please adjust your browser Cookie settings carefully, following the relevant instructions below.

Browser Controls: You may be able to disable and manage some Cookies through your browser settings. If you use multiple browsers on the same device, you will need to manage your settings for each browser. Please click on any of the below browser links for instructions:

**[Google Chrome](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95647?hl=en&p=cpn_cookies)**

**[Apple Safari](https://support.apple.com/en-gb/HT201265)**

If the browser you use is not listed above, please refer to your browser’s help menu for information on how to manage Cookies. Please be aware that disabling cookies will not disable other analytics tools we may use to collect information about you or your use of our Services.

**Analytics Provider Opt-Outs:** To disable analytics Cookies you can use the browser controls discussed above or, for some of our providers, you can use their individual opt-out mechanisms:

**[Google’s Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)** and **[Google Analytics Opt-Out](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout)**

The above are examples of our analytics providers and this is not an exhaustive list. We are not responsible for the effectiveness of any other providers’ opt-out mechanisms.

**Flash Local Storage:** These cookies are also known as local shared objects and may be used to store your preferences or display content by us, advertisers and other third-parties. Flash cookies need to be deleted in the storage section of your Flash Player Settings Manager.

**Interest-Based Advertising:** Most third-party advertisers offer a way to opt out of their interest-based advertising. For more information or to opt out of receiving interest-based advertising from participating third-party advertisers, depending on your country of residence, please visit:

**[Digital Advertising Alliance in the US](http://www.aboutads.info/choices/)**

**[European Interactive Digital Advertising Alliance](http://www.youronlinechoices.com/)**

**[Google’s Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy)** and **[Google Analytics Opt-Out Page](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout)**

After you opt out, you will still see advertisements, but they may not be as relevant to you.

**Mobile Settings:** You may manage the collection of information for interest-based advertising purposes in mobile apps via the device’s settings, including managing the collection of location data. To opt out of mobile ad tracking from Nielsen or other third parties, you can do so by selecting the “Limit Ad Tracking” (for iOS devices) or “Opt out of Ads Personalization” (for Android devices) options in your device settings.

**Connected Devices:** For connected devices, such as smart TVs or streaming devices, you should review the device’s settings and select the option that allows you to disable automatic content recognition or ad tracking. Typically, to opt out, such devices require you to select options like “limit ad tracking” or to disable options such as “interest-based advertising,” “interactive TV,” or “smart interactivity”. These settings vary by device type.

**Cross-Device Tracking:** If you would like to opt out of our browser-based cross-device tracking for advertising purposes, you may do so by using the various methods described above. For more information about cross-device matching, please visit the Network Advertising Initiative or the Digital Advertising Alliance. If you opt out of cross-device tracking for advertising purposes, we may still conduct cross-device tracking for other purposes, such as analytics.

# 게스트로 Chrome 탐색

공용 컴퓨터를 사용하거나 다른 사용자와 컴퓨터를 공유하는 경우 게스트 모드에서 방문한 웹사이트가 브라우저 기록에 표시되지 않습니다.

게스트 모드에서는 다른 Chrome 프로필의 정보를 찾거나 변경할 수 없습니다. 게스트 모드를 종료하면 내 탐색 활동이 컴퓨터에서 삭제됩니다.

게스트 모드의 사용 용도:

*   다른 사용자에게 내 컴퓨터를 빌려주거나 내가 다른 사용자의 컴퓨터를 빌려 쓰는 경우
*   도서관, 카페 등에서 공용 컴퓨터를 사용하는 경우

내 컴퓨터에서 비공개로 탐색하려면 [시크릿 모드를 사용](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95464)하세요. 방문 기록이 저장되지 않으며 내 정보와 설정을 계속 확인할 수 있습니다.

**도움말:** 신뢰할 수 있는 기기에서만 민감한 웹사이트에 로그인하세요.

[컴퓨터](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6130773?hl=ko)[Android 휴대전화 및 태블릿](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6130773?hl=ko)[iPhone/iPad](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/6130773?hl=ko)

더보기
1.   더보기

## 게스트 모드 열기

1.   컴퓨터에서 Chrome을 엽니다.
2.   오른쪽 상단에서 프로필 ![Image 1: 프로필](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/ctV0QX29Bg_C5H9X55WX5qRw0B6TtSqwM-aa0Ftx9kirVzMJU8NZmK0QUC724NV-2_E=w36-h36)을 선택합니다.
3.   **게스트 프로필**을 엽니다.

**도움말:**

*   컴퓨터에 관리 대상 사용자가 있고 관리 대상이 아닌 모든 프로필이 잠금 설정된 경우 게스트 모드를 사용할 수 없습니다.

*   Chromebook에서는 게스트 모드를 사용할 수 없습니다. [Chromebook을 게스트로 사용하는 방법을 알아보세요](https://support.google.com/chromebook/answer/1057090).

## 게스트 모드 종료하기

 게스트 모드를 닫는 방법은 다음과 같습니다. 
*   **Windows 및 Linux:** 오른쪽 상단에서 닫기 ![Image 2: 닫기](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/VYhF4U2_Ulo5TxrJblqA1dFmKF17woYZFvBzgdMXFCGOyf7EoT7mfBDj2f5cDrDO_9I=w36-h36)를 선택합니다.
*   **Mac:** 왼쪽 상단에서 닫기 ![Image 3: 닫기](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/VYhF4U2_Ulo5TxrJblqA1dFmKF17woYZFvBzgdMXFCGOyf7EoT7mfBDj2f5cDrDO_9I=w36-h36)를 선택합니다.

 또는 
1.   오른쪽 상단에서 프로필 ![Image 4: 프로필](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/ctV0QX29Bg_C5H9X55WX5qRw0B6TtSqwM-aa0Ftx9kirVzMJU8NZmK0QUC724NV-2_E=w36-h36)을 선택합니다.
2.   메뉴에서 **게스트 종료**를 선택합니다.

방문 기록, 쿠키, 사이트 데이터가 삭제됩니다.

### 다른 사용자가 게스트 모드에서 볼 수 있는 정보

_**Dark Water**_ is a 2005 American [supernatural horror](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Supernatural_horror "Supernatural horror") film directed by [Walter Salles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walter_Salles "Walter Salles") and written by [Rafael Yglesias](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_Yglesias "Rafael Yglesias"). It is a [remake](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Remake "Remake") of the [2002 Japanese film](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Water_(2002_film) "Dark Water (2002 film)") based on the short story "[Floating Water](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Water_(book) "Dark Water (book)")" by [Koji Suzuki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koji_Suzuki_(writer) "Koji Suzuki (writer)"), who also wrote the [_Ring_ trilogy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ring_(Suzuki_novel) "Ring (Suzuki novel)"). The film stars [Jennifer Connelly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jennifer_Connelly "Jennifer Connelly"), [Tim Roth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tim_Roth "Tim Roth"), [John C. Reilly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_C._Reilly "John C. Reilly"), [Pete Postlethwaite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Postlethwaite "Pete Postlethwaite"), [Perla Haney-Jardine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perla_Haney-Jardine "Perla Haney-Jardine"), [Dougray Scott](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dougray_Scott "Dougray Scott") and [Ariel Gade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ariel_Gade "Ariel Gade").

_Dark Water_ was released on July 8, 2005, and grossed $49.5 million worldwide.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Water_(2005_film)#cite_note-BoxOfficeMojo-2)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Water_(2005_film)#cite_note-numbers-3) It is a co-production between the United States and Japan.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dark_Water_(2005_film)#cite_note-afi-1)

## Plot

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Dark_Water_(2005_film)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Plot")]

Dahlia battles her ex-husband Kyle on shared custody conditions of their five-year-old daughter, Ceci. Kyle wants Ceci to live closer to his apartment in [Jersey City](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jersey_City "Jersey City"), where there is a nearby school and rents are affordable. Dahlia instead chooses a dilapidated complex, with no other children, on [Roosevelt Island](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roosevelt_Island "Roosevelt Island")–despite Ceci being able to access the dangerous and unprotected rooftop and its [water tower](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rooftop_water_tower "Rooftop water tower"). After they move in, the bedroom ceiling leaks dark water. Dahlia finds the apartment above flooded and a family portrait of the former tenants, the Rimsky family: a mother, father, and a girl who is Ceci's age. She complains to the manager and to the superintendent, Veeck, about the water, but they do nothing. Paranoid, she complains to her lawyer, Platzer, that Kyle paid people to damage the plumbing.

Dahlia is haunted by ghostly visions and a recurring nightmare in which Mrs. Rimsky threatens to harm Ceci if Dahlia talks to the police. Ceci's teacher is troubled by her "imaginary friend", Natasha, and Dahlia catches Ceci talking to Natasha as well. In the bathroom, Ceci passes out as dark water gushes from the toilets and sinks.

That night, Dahlia sees water spilling from the water tower. Inside, she finds Natasha's body and calls the police. Veeck is arrested, as he was aware of the body, which was why he refused to fix the complex's plumbing problems. Veeck admits that the Rimskys paid him to keep quiet about their wilful neglect of Natasha. Left to fend for herself, Natasha fell into the water and drowned, becoming a vengeful ghost who is jealous of Ceci.

Dahlia finally decides that perhaps the situation is unsafe for Ceci, and will move closer to Kyle. Dahlia is packing and Ceci is taking a bath when Natasha visits Dahlia, begging her not to leave. Natasha attempts to drown Ceci until Dahlia promises to be her mother, at which point, Natasha drowns Dahlia by flooding the bathroom; they walk the hall together as ghosts.

Ceci moves in with Kyle, who is now given full custody of Ceci. Three weeks later, they pick up the last of her belongings from the old apartmen

본 서비스 약관에는 [Google의 사업 운영 방식](https://about.google/intl/ko_KR/how-our-business-works), Google에 적용되는 법률, [Google이 항상 진실이라고 여기는 특정 내용](https://www.google.com/about/philosophy.html?hl=ko)이 반영되어 있습니다. 따라서 귀하가 Google 서비스와 상호작용하면 본 서비스 약관을 근거로 Google과의 관계가 정의됩니다. 예를 들어, 약관에는 다음과 같은 제목의 주제들이 포함됩니다.

*   [Google에 기대할 수 있는 사항](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#toc-what-you-expect). Google이 서비스를 제공 및 개발하는 방법을 설명합니다.
*   [Google이 귀하에게 기대하는 사항](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#toc-what-we-expect). Google 서비스 사용과 관련된 일정한 규칙들을 정합니다.
*   [Google 서비스 내 콘텐츠](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#toc-content). Google 서비스에서 찾을 수 있는 콘텐츠의 지적 재산권에 대해 설명하며, 이러한 콘텐츠의 소유권이 귀하, Google 또는 다른 사람에게 있는지 설명합니다.
*   [문제 또는 의견 충돌이 있는 경우](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#toc-problems). 귀하가 갖는 기타 법적 권리와 타인이 본 약관을 위반했을 때를 대비해 알아 두어야 할 사항을 설명합니다.

Google 서비스에 액세스하거나 서비스를 이용함으로써 귀하는 본 약관에 동의하게 되므로 본 약관을 숙지하는 것이 중요합니다.

본 약관 외에도 Google은 [개인정보처리방침](https://policies.google.com/privacy?gl=KR&hl=ko)을 게시합니다. 개인정보처리방침은 본 약관에 포함되지는 않지만 [정보의 업데이트, 관리, 내보내기 및 삭제](https://myaccount.google.com/?hl=ko) 방법을 더 잘 이해하기 위해 읽어 볼 것을 권장합니다.

# 귀하와 Google의 관계

본 약관은 귀하와 Google 간의 관계를 정의하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 본 약관에서 'Google' 또는 '당사'는 Google LLC와 그 [계열사](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-affiliates)를 의미합니다. 간단하게 설명하면, 귀하가 [Google의 비즈니스 운영 및 수익 창출 방식](https://about.google/intl/ko_KR/how-our-business-works)이 반영된 본 약관을 따르기로 동의할 경우 Google은 귀하가 Google [서비스](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-services)에 액세스하고 이를 사용할 수 있도록 허락합니다.

## Google에 기대할 수 있는 사항

### 다양하고 유용한 서비스 제공

![Image 5](https://www.gstatic.com/identity/boq/policies/privacy/tos_2024/03-provide-a-broad-range-of-useful-services-lightmode.svg)

당사는 다음을 포함하여 본 약관이 적용되는 다양한 서비스를 제공합니다.
*   앱 및 사이트(예: Google 검색 및 Google 지도)
*   플랫폼(예: Google 쇼핑)
*   결합된 서비스(예: 타사 앱 또는 사이트에 삽입된 Google 지도)
*   기기(예: Google Nest 및 Pixel)

이러한 서비스 중에는 스트림하거나 상호작용할 수 있는 콘텐츠가 포함된 서비스도 많습니다.

Google 서비스는 서로 협업하도록 구성되어 있어, 하나의 활동에서 다음 활동으로 더욱 쉽게 이동할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 Calendar 일정에 주소가 포함된 경우 주소를 클릭하면 Google 지도에 해당 주소의 이동 경로가 표시됩니다.

### Google 서비스 개발, 개선, 업데이트

![Image 6](https://www.gstatic.com/identity/boq/policies/privacy/tos_2024/04-develop-improve-and-update-google-services-lightmode.svg)

Google은 서비스 개선을 위해 지속적으로 새로운 기술 및 기능을 개발합니다. 예를 들어, 동시 번역을 제공하거나 스팸 및 멀웨어를 더 효과적으로 감지하고 차단하기 위해 인공지능과 머신러닝을 사용합니다. Google은 이러한 지속적인 개선의 일환으로 기능을 추가하거나 삭제하고, 서비스에 대한 제한을 늘리거나 줄이며, 새로운 서비스를 제공하거나 기존 서비스의 제공을 중단하기도 합니다. 서비스에 다운로드 가능하거나 선탑재된 소프트웨어가 필요하거나 포함되는 경우 새로운 버전 또는 기능이 제공되면 소프트웨어가 기기에서 자동으로 업데이트되기도 합니다. 일부 서비스의 경우 귀하가 자동 업데이트 설정을 조정할 수 있습니다.

Google은 면밀한 제품 연구 프로그램을 가지고 있어, 서비스를 변경하거나 서비스 제공을 중단하기 전에 사용자로서 귀하의 이해관계, 귀하의 합리적 기대, 귀하 및 다른 사용자에게 미칠 수 있는 잠재적인 영향을 신중하게 고려합니다. Google은 성능 또는 보안을 개선하거나, 법률을 준수하거나, 불법 활동 또는 서비스 악용을 방지하거나, 발전된 기술을 반영하는 등 타당한 사유가 있는 경우, 또는 일부 기능이나 전체 서비스가 더 이상 충분한 인기나 경제성이 없는 경우에만 서비스를 변경하거나 중단합니다.

귀하의 Google 서비스 사용에 부정적인 영향을 미치는 중대한 변경사항이 있거나 서비스 제공을 중단할 경우, Google은 합당한 사전 통지를 전달합니다. 다만, 서비스 악용을 방지하거나, 법적 요구에 응하거나, 보안 및 운용가능성 관련 문제를 해결하는 등 긴급한 상황은 예외로 합니다. 또한 Google은 관련 법률 및 정책에 따라 [Google 테이크아웃](https://takeout.google.com/settings/takeout?hl=ko)을 사용해 Google 계정에서 [귀하의 콘텐츠](https://policies.google.com/terms?gl=KR&hl=ko#footnote-your-content)를 내보낼 기회를 제공합니다.

### 본 약관 및 서비스별 추가 약관 준수

![Image 7](https://www.gstatic.com/identity/boq/policies/privacy/tos_2024/05-follow-these-terms-and-service-specific-additional-terms-lightmode.svg)

Select a rating to know more information about it and movies with this rating

![Image 7: G](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Green_Theat_G.jpg)

![Image 8](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/g_icon.svg)

 All ages admitted 

A G-rated motion picture contains nothing in theme, language, nudity, sex, violence or other matters that, in the view of the Rating Board, would offend parents whose younger children view the motion picture. The G rating is not a "certificate of approval," nor does it signify a "children's" motion picture. Some snippets of language may go beyond polite conversation but they are common everyday expressions. No stronger words are present in G-rated motion pictures. Depictions of violence are minimal. No nudity, sex scenes or drug use are present in the motion picture.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 9: G](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Green_Theat_G.jpg)

![Image 10](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/pg_icon.svg)

 Some material may not be suitable for children 

A PG-rated motion picture should be investigated by parents before they let their younger children attend. The PG rating indicates, in the view of the Rating Board, that parents may consider some material unsuitable for their children, and parents should make that decision.

The more mature themes in some PG-rated motion pictures may call for parental guidance. There may be some profanity and some depictions of violence or brief nudity. But these elements are not deemed so intense as to require that parents be strongly cautioned beyond the suggestion of parental guidance. There is no drug use content in a PG-rated motion picture.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 11: PG](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_PG.jpg)

![Image 12](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/pg-13_icon.svg)

 Some material may be inappropriate for children under 13 

A PG-13 rating is a sterner warning by the Rating Board to parents to determine whether their children under age 13 should view the motion picture, as some material might not be suited for them. A PG-13 motion picture may go beyond the PG rating in theme, violence, nudity, sensuality, language, adult activities or other elements, but does not reach the restricted R category. The theme of the motion picture by itself will not result in a rating greater than PG-13, although depictions of activities related to a mature theme may result in a restricted rating for the motion picture.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 13: PG-13](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_PG13.jpg)

![Image 14](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/r_icon.svg)

 Under 17 requires accompanying parent or adult guardian 

An R-rated motion picture, in the view of the Rating Board, contains some adult material. An R-rated motion picture may include adult themes, adult activity, hard language, intense or persistent violence, sexually-oriented nudity, drug abuse or other elements, so that parents are counseled to take this rating very seriously. Children under 17 are not allowed to attend R-rated motion pictures unaccompanied by a parent or adult guardian. Parents are strongly urged to find out more about R-rated motion pictures in determining their suitability for their children. Generally, it is not appropriate for parents to bring their young children with them to R-rated motion pictures.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 15: R](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_R.jpg)

![Image 16](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/nc-17_icon.svg)

 No One 17 and Under Admitted 

An NC-17 rated motion picture is one that, in the view of the Rating Board, most parents would consider patently too adult for their children 17 and under. No children will be admitted. NC-17 does not mean "obscene" or "pornographic" in the common or legal meaning of those words, and should not be construed as a negative judgment in any sense. The rating simply signals that the content is appropriate only for an adult audience. An NC-17 rating can be based on violence, sex, aberrational behavior, drug abuse or any other element that most parents would consider too strong and therefore off-limits for viewing by their children.

[Learn More About the Ratings](https://www.filmratings.com/ratings-guide/)

![Image 17: NC-17](https://www.filmratings.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Green_Online_NC17.jpg)

_**Amistad**_ is a 1997 American [historical drama](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Historical_drama "Historical drama") film directed by [Steven Spielberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Spielberg "Steven Spielberg") and written by [David Franzoni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Franzoni "David Franzoni"), based on the events in 1839 aboard the Spanish slave ship _[La Amistad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La\_Amistad "La Amistad")_, during which [Mende tribesmen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mende_people "Mende people") abducted for the slave trade managed to gain control of their captors' ship off the coast of [Cuba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuba "Cuba"), and the international [legal battle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_v._The_Amistad "United States v. The Amistad") that followed their capture by the _[Washington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington\_(1837) "Washington (1837)")_, a [U.S. revenue cutter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Revenue_Cutter_Service "United States Revenue Cutter Service"). The case was ultimately [resolved by the U.S. Supreme Court in 1841](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_v._The_Amistad "United States v. The Amistad").

[Morgan Freeman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morgan_Freeman "Morgan Freeman"), [Anthony Hopkins](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthony_Hopkins "Anthony Hopkins"), and [Matthew McConaughey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matthew_McConaughey "Matthew McConaughey") star, along with [Djimon Hounsou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Djimon_Hounsou "Djimon Hounsou") in his breakout role as [Cinqué](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Cinqu%C3%A9 "Joseph Cinqué"); [Pete Postlethwaite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pete_Postlethwaite "Pete Postlethwaite"), [Nigel Hawthorne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigel_Hawthorne "Nigel Hawthorne") and [Chiwetel Ejiofor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chiwetel_Ejiofor "Chiwetel Ejiofor") appear in supporting roles.

_Amistad_ was released by [DreamWorks Pictures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DreamWorks_Pictures "DreamWorks Pictures") on December 10, 1997. The film received largely positive critical reviews and grossed $58.3 million worldwide against a $39 million budget.

## Plot

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amistad_(film)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Plot")]

The [schooner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schooner "Schooner")_La Amistad_ is transporting black slaves off the coast of the [Spanish colony of Cuba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Captaincy_General_of_Cuba "Captaincy General of Cuba") in 1839. A captive, [Cinqué](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joseph_Cinqu%C3%A9 "Joseph Cinqué"), leads an uprising against the crew, most of whom are killed. _**The Congress**_ ([French](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_language "French language"): _Le Congrès_, [Hebrew](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hebrew_language "Hebrew language"): כנס העתידנים) is a 2013 English-language live-action/animated [science-fiction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science_fiction_film "Science fiction film") drama film written and directed by [Ari Folman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ari_Folman "Ari Folman"), loosely based on [Stanisław Lem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanis%C5%82aw_Lem "Stanisław Lem")'s 1971 Polish science-fiction novel _[The Futurological Congress](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Futurological\_Congress "The Futurological Congress")_. It stars [Robin Wright](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robin_Wright "Robin Wright") as a fictionalized version of herself who agrees to have a film studio use a [digital clone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_clone "Digital clone") of her in any film they want.

The film premiered at the [2013 Cannes Film Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2013_Cannes_Film_Festival "2013 Cannes Film Festival") on 15 May 2013.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Congress_(2013_film)#cite_note-Cannes_2013-8) Independent film distributor [Drafthouse Films](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drafthouse_Films "Drafthouse Films") announced, along with Films We Like In Toronto, their co-acquisition of the North American rights to the film and a US theatrical and VOD/digital release planned for 2014.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Congress_(2013_film)#cite_note-Drafthouse-9)

## Plot

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Congress_(2013_film)&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Plot")]

[Robin Wright](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robin_Wright "Robin Wright") is an aging actress whose career suffered because of her erratic behavior and reputation for being fickle and unreliable. Her son, Aaron, suffers from [Usher syndrome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Usher_syndrome "Usher syndrome"), which is slowly destroying his sight and hearing. Aided by Dr. Barker, Robin barely manages to stave off the worst effects of Aaron's decline, although his condition is sliding into its terminal stage.

Robin's longtime agent, Al, takes her to meet Jeff Green, the CEO of Miramount Studios, a film studio that offers to buy her likeness and digitize her into a computer-animated version of herself. Realizing that she may be unable to find future work with the emergence of this new technology, Robin agrees to do it for a hefty sum of money. The contract also requires that she never act again. After her body is digitally scanned, the studio can make films starring her, using only [computer-generated characters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virtual_actor "Virtual actor").

Twenty years later, Robin travels to Abrahama City, where she will speak at the "Futurological Congress", Miramount's entertainment conference. Abrahama City is an animated, surreal [utopia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Utopia "Utopia") that is created from figments of people's [imaginations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imagination "Imagination"), where anyone can become an animated [avatar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar_(computing) "Avatar (computing)") of themselves but must use [hallucinogenic drugs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hallucinogen "Hallucinogen") to enter a mutable [illusory state](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Illusion "Illusion"). In the decades since she was scanned, Robin's virtual persona has become the star of a popular film franchise, _Rebel Robot Robin_, making her and Tom Cruise the only remaining movie stars. While discussing her new contract with Jeff, Robin learns that Miramount developed a new technology that will allow anyone to devour her or possibly [transform themselves](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shapeshifting "Shapeshifting") into her with the hallucinogen. Robin agrees to the deal, but has a crisis of conscience, believing that no one should be turned into a product.

When asked to speak to the public at the Congress, Robin publicly voices her contrary views, upsetting everyone there before being taken by security guards. The Congress is then interrupted by rebels opposed to the technology industry. They seemingly assassinate the head of the Congress. During the attack, Robin is rescued by Dylan Truliner, who was Miramount's lead animator for her films. They escape, but she is soon captured by "Miramount Police". Robin is seemingly executed by Jeff as a punishment for rebelling against Miramount and the Congress. Robin is shown on a hospital bed while doctors discuss her case. One doctor reveals that Robin's execution was her hallucinating, that her rescuers were from Miramount. The doctors decide that Robin has become so intoxicated by the hallucinogen that she must be frozen until a treatment for her condition can be found.

Twenty years later, Robin is revived while still hallucinating an animated world. She reunites with Dylan, who says that the hallucinogenic technology is now widespread. The third season of the American [horror](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horror_fiction "Horror fiction")[anthology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthology_series "Anthology series") television series _[American Horror Story](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American\_Horror\_Story "American Horror Story")_, subtitled _**Coven**_, is set in 2013 [New Orleans](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_Orleans "New Orleans") and follows a [coven](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coven "Coven") of [witches](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Witches "Witches") descended from [Salem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salem,_Massachusetts "Salem, Massachusetts") as they fight for survival and features flashbacks to the [Salem witch trials](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salem_witch_trials "Salem witch trials") in 1692, as well as the 1830s, 1910s, 1960s, 1970s, and 1990s. The [ensemble cast](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ensemble_cast "Ensemble cast") includes [Sarah Paulson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarah_Paulson "Sarah Paulson"), [Taissa Farmiga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taissa_Farmiga "Taissa Farmiga"), [Frances Conroy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frances_Conroy "Frances Conroy"), [Evan Peters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evan_Peters "Evan Peters"), [Lily Rabe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lily_Rabe "Lily Rabe"), [Emma Roberts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emma_Roberts "Emma Roberts"), [Denis O'Hare](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denis_O'Hare "Denis O'Hare"), [Kathy Bates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kathy_Bates "Kathy Bates"), and [Jessica Lange](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jessica_Lange "Jessica Lange"), with all returning from previous seasons, except Roberts and Bates. The season marks the first to not feature cast mainstays [Dylan McDermott](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dylan_McDermott "Dylan McDermott") and [Zachary Quinto](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zachary_Quinto "Zachary Quinto").

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress

The 2026 recipient: Amy Madigan

Awarded for	Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role
Country	United States
Presented by	Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS)
First award	March 4, 1937; 89 years ago (for films released in 1936)
Most recent winner	Amy Madigan, Weapons (2025)
Most awards	Dianne Wiest and Shelley Winters (2)
Most nominations	Thelma Ritter (6)
Website	oscars.org

The Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress is an award presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS). It has been awarded since the 9th Academy Awards to an actress who has delivered an outstanding performance in a supporting role in a film released that year. The award is traditionally presented by the previous year's Best Supporting Actor winner. However, in recent years, it has shifted towards being presented by previous years' Best Supporting Actress winners instead. In lieu of the traditional Oscar statuette, supporting acting recipients were given plaques up until the 16th Academy Awards,[1] when statuettes were awarded to each category instead.[2]

The Best Supporting Actress award has been presented a total of 90 times, to 88 actresses. The first winner was Gale Sondergaard for her role in Anthony Adverse (1936). The most recent winner is Amy Madigan for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons (2025).[3] The record for most wins is two, held jointly by Dianne Wiest and Shelley Winters. Each other recipient has only won once, in this category. Thelma Ritter has received the most nominations in the category, with six, followed closely by Amy Adams with five, although neither has ever won—yet, in the latter's instance. Hattie McDaniel, whom the Academy sat in the back of the room, made history in 1940 when she became the first person of color to win an Oscar in any category, for her performance as Mammy in Gone with the Wind (1939).[4]

Tatum O'Neal remains the youngest person to win a competitive acting Oscar at 10 years old, for her role in Paper Moon (1973). With five minutes and two seconds of screentime (the majority in one scene), Beatrice Straight's performance in Network (1976) holds the record for the shortest to win an Oscar.[5] The 40-year gap between Madigan's nomination for Weapons and her previous one for Twice in a Lifetime (1985) set the record for longest gap between Oscar nominations for an actress.[6]

Nominations processedit

Nominees are currently determined by single transferable vote within the actors branch of AMPAS; winners are selected by a plurality vote from the entire eligible voting members of the Academy.[7]

**Daniel Sallis Huston** (born May 14, 1962) is an American actor, director, and screenwriter. A member of the Huston family of filmmakers, he is the son of director [John Huston](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Huston "John Huston") and half-brother of actress [Anjelica Huston](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anjelica_Huston "Anjelica Huston").

He is known for his roles in films such as _[Ivans Xtc](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivans\_Xtc "Ivans Xtc")_ (2000),[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Danny_Huston#cite_note-:0-1) for which he was
